p: "And they would escort him to his home,

at the time that he came out in peace from the Holy"
It does not say "when he came out,"

and in the piyut it says
and the implication is that it was not over the miracle alone

so that it would be as it will be in the time to come.

And likewise afterward, on the festival,

שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ לֹא טַעַם וְלֹא רֵיחַ,

"And all the men of Israel gathered

And now that we have no Kohen,
"we will render for bulls the offering of our lips"
for if one intended to do it
and was prevented and did not do it,
it is likewise as if he had done it
it is a festive day for all Israel.
